whole_run._intent: run_cnaster patched against --no-patch, wall time and peak RSS, each arm in its own process. key_instance (10,000 x 5,000) does not fit unpatched -- 8 GB of emission array against 15 GB available (#90) -- so the comparison runs at the largest instance both arms complete and the badge label carries it. whole_run.note: Median of 3 pairs, each arm in its own process, on an otherwise idle host. The median rather than the mean because the runtime ratios span 1.1016 to 1.2068 -- 10 per cent, the same order as the effect -- and nearly all of that is the patched arm (9.5 per cent spread against the unpatched arm's 2.6). Below CLAUDE.md's 2x bar, so this is a simplification rather than a speedup, and the badge is coloured to say so. Peak RSS does not move: at this instance the emission array is not what dominates, which is a fact about the instance rather than about the patch (#90).
